name: Sarpy County, NE
findings: Sarpy County has 490 nonprofit organizations. 216 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 174 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sarpy County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Sarpy County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 political organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do political organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
